t: Zombies and Skeletons of all kinds, Creepers, and even the Zombie Piglins are all showing their Holiday Spirit by wearing Ugly Sweaters and Santa Hats! $(br2)Mobs wearing the armor have a random chance to drop the armor pieces.
各类僵尸与骷髅、苦力怕，甚至僵尸猪灵，都正通过身着丑毛衣与圣诞老人帽子展现节日精神！$(br2)穿戴该盔甲的怪物有一定几率掉落盔甲部件。
A Zombie in an Ugly Sweater. He's ready to party!
一位身着丑毛衣的僵尸。他已准备好狂欢啦！
Note: This feature is customizable and can be disabled in the config file. $(br2)Ugly Armor drops from mobs can also be disabled in the config file.
注意：此功能支持自定义，可在配置文件中禁用。$(br2)丑毛衣盔甲的怪物掉落也可在配置文件中禁用。
